states.name: run
states.trigger: On the ground, moving, hands empty, Space (0x200) not held: controller target speed 0x700
states.note: Upper body slot 0 over legs slot 1; playback scales with ground speed (x0x30/65536); left/right footstep dust and sounds 0/1 at steps 2 and 10.

states.name: candidate Z-key move (unnamed)
states.trigger: 0x0059D98A < 0: Z (Ctrl+Space, bits 0x8200) or Space+Ctrl on the ground with empty hands sets it to -16; it climbs to 0 in 16 updates. A faced enemy touched meanwhile is repelled (state 0x1E) instead of hurting Flik

states.name: candidate ground-pound hover
states.trigger: Shift pressed again while falling more than 0x2000 above ground: sound 0x1B, movement state 4, hover counter 0x0059D994 = 10 (vertical velocity held at 0), then a dive at +0x1000; this state when falling at <= 0x100
states.note: Holds slot 3 frame 11 through the dive. EXP-20260930-004 calls movement state 4 gliding; this trace reads it as hover-then-dive. Both readings are recorded; a runtime arm decides.

states.name: jump/launch rise
states.trigger: Set on a jump or any launch (stomp/bump 0x0041C9B0, mushroom/plant bounces 0x00468010, plant growth 0x00468BF0, level hazards); airborne
states.note: Upper slot 5 + lower slot 6, frames 0-5, holds frame 5.

states.name: jump fall
states.trigger: Airborne state 3 becomes 4 once vertical velocity 0x0059D940 > 0 (falling); 8 also becomes 4 in the air
states.note: Same slots 5+6, frames 6-11, holds frame 11.

states.name: landing
states.trigger: State 4 when ground contact 0x0059D992 returns; plays landing sound 3 except in Riverbed Flight (8)
states.note: Same slots 5+6, frames 12-17, then ends (state 0 re-evaluated).

states.name: candidate ground-pound recovery
states.trigger: On the ground with 0x0059D98A in 1..11 (counting down from the impact) or the hover counter 0x0059D994 nonzero

states.name: candidate ground-pound hover (fast entry)
states.trigger: As state 2 when falling faster than 0x100 at the second Shift press
states.note: Starts slot 3 at frame 3.

states.name: hurt recoil
states.trigger: Invulnerability 0x0059D9A2 > 0x21: a non-fatal hit sets 0x2D, so about 12 updates; respawn sets 0x23

states.name: pick up / uproot (lift)
states.trigger: Carry counter 0x0059D9B3 in 1..0xB after Ctrl near a seed or grown plant (counts 8 -> 0xB)

states.name: Anthill Pt 2 actor bounce
states.trigger: Anthill Pt 2 (0x00861C84 = 9) updater: landing from more than 0x1000 up on actor slot 2 or 3 (velocity -0xC00)
states.note: The bounced-on actors are not identified.

states.name: carry walk
states.trigger: Carry counter >= 0xC (object in hand) and moving
states.note: Playback scales with ground speed (x0x60/65536); footsteps at steps 5 and 17.

states.name: carry stand
states.trigger: Carry counter >= 0xC and standing

states.name: propeller lift / spin cheat
states.trigger: Propeller (plant type 3) updraft in 0x00468010, or the cheat Up, Right, Down, Left twice (0x004DC7D8, each a lone direction; 20 idle frames break it); kept while moving fast
states.note: Repeats sound 0x40 every 60 + random updates while active.

states.name: throw carried object
states.trigger: Ctrl while carrying a plant or a seed in seed-state < 3: the object is thrown forward
states.note: One-shot (slot 18, 8 frames), then state 0.

states.name: death
states.trigger: Level-done 0x0059A5B0 == 2 (health underflow or the Cliffside bird)
states.note: One third speed; freezes on frame 15.

states.name: candidate hang from seed
states.trigger: Carry counter == 0xE: Ctrl on a seed in seed-state >= 3; 0x0043ED60 pulls Flik 0x1000 above the seed and clears ground contact

states.name: let go of seed
states.trigger: Ctrl again while hanging (seed-state >= 3): released without velocity; lasts while Flik falls

states.name: slow fall (type-8 plant top or held propeller)
states.trigger: Float mode 0x0059D9AE == 0xB (touched a type-8 plant top; fall speed capped at 0x15E) or 0xC (holding an uprooted propeller, fall capped at 0x200) while more than 0x1000 above ground
states.note: Berry throws here use overlay slot 23; they are blocked while holding the propeller (0x0044051C).

states.name: carried off by bird
states.trigger: Cliffside (6) bird hazard 0x00434620 phase 1; ends in death

states.name: turn in place left (C+Left)
states.trigger: C (0x400) held with Left (0x80), no throw counting down; heading changes by 0x20 per update
states.note: Half speed, footstep events at steps 3 and 7.

states.name: turn in place right (C+Right)
states.trigger: C (0x400) held with Right (0x20), no throw counting down; heading changes by 0x20 per update
states.note: Shares the script of state 0x14.

states.name: idle
states.trigger: Standing with no input after any non-idle state
states.note: Half-speed loop. Each pass through frame 11 has a 1-in-4 chance (low two bits of the next random byte zero) to start a random fidget from the level's idle table, unless flag 0x4 of 0x0059D9A0 is set.

states.name: idle fidget (slot 29)
states.trigger: Random pick from the idle-fidget table while idling (state 0x16 at frame 11)
states.note: One-shot, then idle again.

states.name: idle fidget (slot 30)
states.trigger: Random pick from the idle-fidget table while idling (state 0x16 at frame 11)
states.note: One-shot, then idle again.

states.name: idle fidget (slot 27)
states.trigger: Random pick from the idle-fidget table while idling (state 0x16 at frame 11)
states.note: One-shot, then idle again.

states.name: idle fidget (slot 28)
states.trigger: Random pick from the idle-fidget table while idling (state 0x16 at frame 11)
states.note: One-shot, then idle again.

states.name: idle fidget (slot 31)
states.trigger: Random pick from the idle-fidget table while idling (state 0x16 at frame 11)
states.note: One-shot, then idle again.

states.name: candidate ground-pound impact
states.trigger: 0x0059D98A == 12: landing in movement state 4 (particle ring, effect 0x5B, sound 0x10); Shift held at speed >= 0x300 keeps it at 12

states.name: walk (Space held)
states.trigger: On the ground, moving, hands empty, input bits 0x300 held; Space (0x200) caps target speed at 0x300
states.note: Playback scales with ground speed (x0x60/65536); footsteps at steps 5 and 17.

states.name: shove stunned enemy
states.trigger: Actor contact 0x0041C9B0 while facing an enemy in carry states 0xB/0xC/0x1E or with 0x0059D98A < 0: the enemy is stunned and pushed
states.note: One-shot.

states.name: candidate tired idle (no hits left)
states.trigger: Health 0x0059D9A4 == 0 (alive, next hit kills) while standing; sound 0x50 at frame 3 unless still playing

states.name: unreachable (absent slot 26)
states.trigger: No write of 0x20 to 0x0059D998 exists; its slot 26 is absent in every player model
states.note: Its script pointer 0x004C1C70 runs into the next script, so the decoded step count is an artifact.

states.name: idle fidget (slot 37)
states.trigger: Random pick from the idle-fidget table while idling (state 0x16 at frame 11)
states.note: One-shot, then idle again.

states.name: idle fidget (slot 38)
states.trigger: Random pick from the idle-fidget table while idling (state 0x16 at frame 11)
states.note: One-shot, then idle again.

slots.name: berry throw (upper-body overlay)
slots.note: Replaces layer A for 18 updates (frame = 0x12 - counter 0x0059D996) when the state is layered; the berry leaves at counter 10 (0x00440555).

slots.name: unreferenced
slots.note: 24 frames; no static reference to this slot anywhere in the executable.

slots.name: berry throw (standing)
slots.note: Used when the current state is idle-family; the state becomes 0x16.

slots.name: unreferenced
slots.note: 13 frames; no static reference to this slot anywhere in the executable.

slots.name: slow fall (type-8 plant top or held propeller)
berry throw (slow fall)
slots.note: Used when layer B is slot 16 (state 0x12).

slots.name: absent
slots.note: Zero offset in every player model; only unreachable state 0x20 names it.

slots.name: swing on hanging strand
slots.note: Header +0x88 while 0x0059D99C holds a grabbed strand (table 0x007EEE68); frame = (0x380 - offset along heading, clamped to +-0x280) << 9, frames 2-12, so the pose follows the swing, not time.

notes: All labels are static evidence (decompiler plus fresh objdump of the retail executable); no runtime arm has confirmed a state number yet.

Default keys (0x0042F100): Up 0x10, Right 0x20, Down 0x40, Left 0x80, Ctrl 0x8000 (throw/pick up), Shift 0x4000 (jump), Space 0x200 (walk), Z 0x8200, C 0x400 (turn in place), Alt 0x1000, Return 0x8, X 0x800.
Movement state 4 (0x0059D990) is called gliding in EXP-20260930-004 and reads as a hover-then-dive ground pound here; unresolved.
Layer names upper/lower are inferred: layer-A slots drive parts 9-20 and are swapped for the berry-throw overlay; layer-B slots drive parts 0-8, whose part 8 carries the extra channel.

Entity animations (FLIKHARV, ATTAFLIK) are chosen by creature-VM opcode 0x0D (0x0041E00D) or helper 0x0041DC20: slot at actor +0x44, frame script 0x004C8754[n], rate bytes +0x48/+0x49. No entity reuses Flik's player headers: 0x0044515B zeroes the ID-0 header word that 0x0044846D tests.

other_models.name: Flik's rideable harvester
other_models.summary: Actor slot 63 (entity type 0x23, VM script 34), driven by the global hook 0x00415E30. Placed in Anthill (1), Tunnels (3), City Square (5), Clover Forest (7), Riverbed Canyon (10) and The Tree (12). Ctrl beside it on the ground mounts it (0x0059D9A0 |= 0x80, sound 0x32, part modes via 0x00446870); Shift or a hit dismounts.

slots.name: ridden, moving
slots.trigger: Flik mounted and moving; frame script 1, rate scales with his ground speed (0x00416038)

slots.name: ridden, standing
slots.trigger: Flik mounted and standing; frame script 2 at one frame per update (0x00416014)

slots.name: parked
slots.trigger: Unoccupied: VM script 34 at half rate, the Shift dismount (0x00440238) or the hit dismount (0x0041C891)

other_models.name: Atta-and-Flik player stand-in (Riverbed Flight)
other_models.summary: Actor slot 39 (entity type 0x15, VM script 19), only in Riverbed Flight (8, LEVEL08/LEVEL.RAW). Level handler 0x004362D0 copies Flik's position and heading into it every update and sets 0x0059D9A0 bit 0 (0x0043634A), which makes Flik's renderer skip him (0x0044C51A). In that level these are the player's visible animations.

slots.name: candidate flight loop
slots.trigger: Default; restored after hurt and throw (0x00436434, 0x0043647C)

slots.name: hurt
slots.trigger: Invulnerability 0x0059D9A2 == 0x2C (a fresh hit); frame script 6, back to slot 0 at frame 27

slots.name: berry throw
slots.trigger: Throw counter 0x0059D996 == 0x12 (Ctrl); frame script 4, back to slot 0 at frame 17

slots.name: death
slots.trigger: Health below 0; frame script 9 at half rate, holds frame 30
